purpose: Nonlinear out-of-fold stacking using local base verifiers and input features.
inner_base_cache: Existing V7 5 outer x 3 inner OOF of frozen V2 recipe, signature/hash/index verified
features: Own tree107 + independent trajectory20, question centered differences, PCA32 raw/difference/context, V2 component raw/group evidence; PCA fit on outer training inputs only
score: Sigmoid logits then mean within parsed answer; fixed heads separately and equal-probability average
normalization: Center only valid candidates; divide each model by its first-seed train OOF std. Reference same normalization. No new weights or hyperparameters after viewing results.
preservation: Existing V2 files, original V2 ZIPs and r2 archives remain unchanged
caveats: Inner-training sample sizes differ from full-train base OOF; no held labels used for fitting.
Frozen V2 model/scales were historically selected on development data, so this is a conditional stability check, not a never-touched holdout.
Repeated validation results do not establish test improvement or leaderboard percentile.
